loss_event_definition: A ransomware deployment causing material clinical or business service disruption; non-disruptive intrusion attempts do not draw these losses.
severity_probability_scope: Conditional on a disruptive ransomware event, not conditional on an attempt or initial compromise.

sampling.financial_components: triangular per severity; sum 8 distinct nonoverlapping components
sampling.clinical_indicators: triangular per severity; report separately from financial total

loss_component_definitions.restoration: Digital forensic recovery, system rebuilding and restoration vendors; excludes response coordination labor
loss_component_definitions.response: Incident response consultants and response coordination; excludes restoration vendors
loss_component_definitions.interruption: Net contribution lost from canceled or deferred care not recovered later; excludes future reputation-driven patient loss
loss_component_definitions.continuity: Patient diversion, temporary clinical workarounds, and contracted emergency capacity; exclude lost contribution already in interruption
loss_component_definitions.notification: Patient notification, credit monitoring and breach assessment; conditional on data exposure, use exposure gate later
loss_component_definitions.legal: Legal counsel, settlements, and conditional regulatory outcomes; no automatic HIPAA fine
loss_component_definitions.reputation: Future net contribution lost from persistent patient-volume decline after service restoration; excludes outage-period loss
loss_component_definitions.extra_staff: Incremental overtime and temporary staffing not already included in response or continuity

gates_to_add_in_engine.data_exfiltration: Notification and privacy-related legal costs require an explicit data-exposure branch; no automatic breach from encryption alone
gates_to_add_in_engine.reputation: Use separate post-restoration volume decline assumptions; do not monetize trust index independently
gates_to_add_in_engine.patient_safety: No fabricated death count; patient diversion and delays are exposure indicators, not automatically monetized

modeling_cautions: Asset daily disruption cost in Package 1 is a prioritization proxy and must not be added to sampled total loss.
Severity probabilities must be applied only after ransomware deployment and disruption; Package 2 contains upstream conditional probabilities.
Loss distributions are provisional, subject to sensitivity testing and plausibility checks against the hospital financial baseline.
Costs are per disruptive incident; annual loss requires simulating event frequency and summing across simulated incidents.
Do not treat 0-100 trust index as a validated clinical or reputational metric.
